highlights: 修复工作区暂未分配时丢弃新 Cookie 的问题；保存轮换后的登录态，但不把未确认会话标成成功。
浏览器插件升级至 1.0.3：按当前普通/无痕窗口读取 Cookie，避免导入另一个窗口的账号；找不到存储区时停止导入。
图片和视频采用独立排队时限（默认 3600 秒，0 为不限）；排队不消耗生成预算，失败记录保留账号、尝试次数和原始错误。
检查更新只读：如实区分本地版本/提交与远端状态；有更新时提醒，由管理员手动确认升级，任务排队或运行期间拒绝更新。
媒体库只加载视频缩略图，点击后才加载所选视频，关闭预览释放播放器；源部署需 FFmpeg，Docker 用户请重建镜像。
组合修复聊天与媒体的资源获取顺序、排队设置跨域 PUT 和固定提交版本读取；继续保留独立代理、轮询及会话健康检查。
请先更新服务，再手动升级插件 1.0.3：替换原目录并重新加载；每个浏览器个人资料分别升级，无痕模式还需允许扩展运行。油猴脚本仍为 1.1.2。
highlights_en: Preserve cookies rotated by unassigned-workspace responses without marking an unconfirmed session healthy.
Extension 1.0.3 reads the active regular/incognito window cookie store and stops instead of importing from another store when identification fails.
Image/video queue waits have a separate budget (3600 seconds by default; 0 means unlimited). Failed tasks retain account, attempt and original error.
Update checks are read-only and report installed provenance separately. Updates notify administrators and require explicit confirmation; queued/running work blocks upgrades.
The media library lazily loads video thumbnails and requests a video only on playback. Source deployments need FFmpeg; Docker users should rebuild images.
Integration fixes align chat/media resource acquisition, allow queue-setting PUT preflights and bind remote version metadata to one commit.
Update the service, then manually upgrade extension 1.0.3 in every browser profile by replacing files and reloading. Allow the extension in Incognito/InPrivate when needed. Userscript remains 1.1.2.
